origin: the task gate's bounded opt-in — auto to the end of the current plan phase — had no walk. The property that matters is that the bound is the phase for real: a bounded auto set on the last planned task must still carry the tasks the consolidation boundary adds to the same phase, and only the phase's record may end it, so the next phase's first task gates again. This walks exactly that: bounded chosen at pay-1-2's gate, the consolidation task pay-1-3 approved at the boundary walk and then built with no stop, the phase record returning the gate to gated, and pay-2-1 stopping at a menu
answers: b — auto-approve to the end of this phase, then gate again
